# Coyle & Edmund Carrow

- [Coyle](../character/coyle.md) — Enemy of — [Edmund Carrow](../character/edmund-carrow.md) — brawled with him after Dan insulted his mother and Grace · since v5  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER XVI. ## Shared scenes

> [Grace](../character/grace.md) walks through the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) with [Edmund Carrow](../character/edmund-carrow.md), enduring an insult from [Dan Coyle](../character/coyle.md) on her way to visit [Lionel Fairlie](../character/lionel-fairlie.md). When she arrives at Lionel's residence, he berates and dismisses her request for him to return to church. Furious at his treatment, [Grace](../character/grace.md) marches back into his house to confront him.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P0](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0000), [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P22](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0022), [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P27](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0027), [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P50](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0050)_

> After church, [Lionel Fairlie](../character/lionel-fairlie.md) briefly speaks with Mr. Ashdown and [Grace](../character/grace.md). On Monday, [Dan Coyle](../character/coyle.md) taunts [Grace](../character/grace.md) and Mrs. [Carrow](../character/carrow.md), prompting [Edmund Carrow](../character/edmund-carrow.md) to defend them and challenge Dan to a fight. The following evening, despite his initial dread and anxiety, Edmund fiercely fights Dan at school, forces him to take back his insults, and then encounters Mr. Ashdown on his way home.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XVII. A DOUBLE VICTORY

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XVII. A DOUBLE VICTORY P3](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0003), [v5 CHAPTER XVII. A DOUBLE VICTORY P11](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0011), [v5 CHAPTER XVII. A DOUBLE VICTORY P12](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0012), [v5 CHAPTER XVII. A DOUBLE VICTORY P43](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0043)_

> Edmund finishes his fight with [Dan Coyle](../character/coyle.md), forcing Dan to retract his insults. On his way home through [Fern Hollow](../codex/places.md#fern-hollow), Edmund encounters Mr. Ashdown, who praises him for defending the honor of women. Later, after [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) tends to Edmund's bruises, Miss Winifred and [Tabitha](../character/tabitha.md) discuss the fight as well as rumors regarding Mr. Ashdown courting [Clementine Ainslie](../character/clementine-ainslie.md).
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XVII. A DOUBLE VICTORY
